steps.caption: Open Capture and scroll to Add files.
Open 'Link to a record' and set 'What is it?' to Business card (or leave Detect).
Choose the photo of Meera Joshi's card.
Practice mode cannot read photos ('photo text not read'), so no name, email or phone was found yet.
Type the card text into 'Text (if the file couldn't be read)'. With AI set up this is read for you.
The fields: name, title, company, email, phones, website and address — copied exactly as on the card.
Phones are typed: mobile from 'M:'. The 'Ph:' number could be direct or switchboard, so it is marked unknown.
Check these: uncertain fields — the unlabelled phone, and an email domain that differs from the website.
No existing contact matches, so a new contact is suggested.
Proposals: a new person and a new company — they wait for your approval in Review.
After you approve the person, press Process again to propose the emails and phones.
Now a card for someone you already know: Anil Deshmukh. Back to Capture.
Business card again, and choose Anil's card.
Type the card text and Process again.
High-confidence match: the same email already belongs to Anil Deshmukh, so no new person is created.
Only the new mobile number is proposed for his record. Same name alone would be a suggestion, never a merge.
The company on the card looks like Marigold Loop Technologies — pick it in the link picker if it is the same.
